T: Drive the cattle north. Eat like a drover.
D: An English aristocrat and a rough drover take a herd of cattle across northern Australia on the eve of war.
P: Serve the mains when the drive makes camp for the night.
S: Baked damper bread with a crisp cross on top, served with butter and golden syrup.
Self-raising flour with butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes, with butter and golden syrup.
Puff pastry cases of creamy prawns and dill.

Crisp puff pastry cases filled with prawns in a lemony dill and mayo dressing, topped with a whole prawn, chives and a pinch of paprika. Bake 16 ready-made vol-au-vent cases at 180C for 8 minutes and cool. Peel 500g cooked prawns, keep 16 whole for the tops and chop the rest. Mix the chopped prawns with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest and juice of half a lemon, chopped dill and a pinch of salt. Fill the cases, top each with a whole prawn, snipped chives and a dusting of paprika.
Sliced corned beef, hot mustard and mustard pickles on buttered white bread.
Corned silverside simmered 3 hours with onion and peppercorns, sliced thin onto buttered bread with hot mustard and mustard pickles.
M: Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes slow-cooked in stock until it falls apart.
Beef chuck browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot, potato and stock, covered and cooked over coals or at 160C for 3 hours, thyme and pepper.
Darwin crisp-skin barra with lemon butter
Barramundi pan-fried skin down until crackling, with lemon butter, chips and a wedge of lemon.

Barramundi pan-fried skin side down until the skin crackles, with brown lemon butter, thick chips and lemon. Pat 4 barramundi fillets dry and score the skin. Fry skin side down in hot oil for 5 minutes, pressing flat, then turn for 1 minute. Melt 60g butter until nutty, add the juice of a lemon and spoon over. Serve with thick-cut chips fried twice and lemon wedges.
W: Crisp meringue with whipped cream and passionfruit.
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream and passionfruit pulp.
K: Drover's rum and ginger beer billy punch
Cold black tea, dark rum, lime and ginger beer in a big pot, ladled into mugs.

Dark rum, spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a splash of billy tea mixed in a big pot over ice, served in enamel mugs with mint. Brew 400ml strong black tea and chill. In a large pot or jug mix the tea with 240ml dark rum, the juice of 4 limes and 3 tbsp brown sugar, stirring to dissolve. Add plenty of ice and top with 750ml cold ginger beer. Ladle into enamel mugs with a lime wedge and mint. Leave out the rum for a booze-free pot.

s.note: Baked damper bread with a crisp cross on top, served with butter and golden syrup.
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour until crumbly. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until it just comes together. Shape into a round, score a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow when tapped. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

s.note: Sliced corned beef, hot mustard and mustard pickles on buttered white bread.
s.how: Simmer a 1.5kg corned silverside with an onion and a spoon of peppercorns for 3 hours, then cool in the liquid. Slice thinly and pile onto buttered white bread with a smear of hot mustard and a spoon of mustard pickles. Cut into triangles.

m.note: Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes slow-cooked in stock until it falls apart.
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in a camp oven or heavy pot. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes in chunks and 750ml beef stock with thyme and pepper. Cover and cook over coals or at 160C for 3 hours until the beef falls apart.

w.note: Meringue with white vinegar, whipped cream and passionfruit.
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a teaspoon of cornflour and a teaspoon of white vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream and passionfruit.
